<thought>The spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced by ~1.003 Da with a decreasing intensity envelope typical of 13C isotopic distribution in an organic molecule. No 2 Da spaced patterns (Cl, Br) or single‑peak elements (I, F) are evident, and the relative intensities do not match sulfur or nitrogen patterns. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
